card.name: Just before the word square in areas
card.fires_on: The last digit of a number or the word "per" right before "square" or "sq" in an area or density measure. It fires in geography and science text, such as land area in square miles or kilometers.

modes.label: Number before square
modes.description: The final digit of an area figure just before a unit like square miles or square feet.

modes.label: Per before square
modes.description: The word "per" in a rate such as price or pressure per square unit.

card.writes: It promotes the word "square" and its variants, predicting that an area unit comes next.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say "square" as in square miles or square feet.
